```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
DATASET <- "QDS"
PathDataset <- file.path(root, "data", "datasets", sprintf("%s.csv", DATASET))
PathSources <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv")
PathScenarios <- file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv")
if (any(!file.exists(c(PathDataset, PathSources, PathScenarios)))) {
  stop("model.domain: required model products are missing.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- "Observed distance--charge domain of the QDS dataset used for model fitting, by data source, and scenario grid for the evaluated predictive level. Logarithmic axes retain the full observed range; scenario points identify demand conditions, not a record selection."
}
if (!exists("GROUP_LEGEND", inherits = FALSE)) GROUP_LEGEND <- "Set"
if (!exists("GRID_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) GRID_LABEL <- "Scenario grid"
SOURCE_COLORS <- setNames(
  c("#00838f", "rgba(110,110,110,0.28)", "#d95f02"),
  c("IMPALA", "S11D", GRID_LABEL)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-model-domain
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "model.domain.R"))
PLOT
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, DATASET, GRID_LABEL, GROUP_LEGEND, PathDataset, PathScenarios,
   PathSources, SOURCE_COLORS)
```
